Subject: CAIQ: sample request and control mapping (Helios Health)

Hi Kimberly / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team has completed an initial review and we need a short CAIQ package to progress procurement. Specifically we need: 

- A completed CAIQ extract limited to the controls in the attached PDF (CSA IDs listed: CCM.6.1, CCM.6.2, CCM.7.3, CCM.11.4, CCM.13.0, CCM.14.1).
- For each control: a one-line Redwood assertion, control owner (name/title), and a single representative artifact (log extract, runbook snippet, diagram, or attestation).
- Evidence window: samples from the last 90 days where applicable (token logs, key rotation events).
- Confirmation of tenancy boundaries (how tenant data is isolated at inference runtime).

Can you confirm by EOD Monday PST whether you can provide a mapped CAIQ CSV and an evidence manifest with delivery dates? If possible, please include a secure link to the artifact bundle. We prefer an access-controlled Drive folder and a short intake checklist.

Attachments: helios_caiq_questions.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
